native_event_lowering: the macro words are source-bound at the primitive wrapper level; full tape admission remains the inherited interface

precision_envelope.convention: Complex coefficient modulus; input components <= 1, initial errors zero. Each query and rational ADD has absolute local error <= epsilon; COPY, signed permutation maps and owned CLEAR are exact. The local error budgets must still be supplied by physical implementations.

scope: literal macro resource upper bound; no new positive-rank children and all added raw events explicit
